overall_goal: Prepare chicken stock and add it to the pan

goals.description: Prepare a mug with hot water
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a mug from a drawer and pours hot water into it from the kettle.

goals.description: Get and unwrap a stock cube
goals.rationale: The person fetches a stock cube from the fridge, unwraps it, drops it into the mug, and cleans up the packaging.

goals.description: Dissolve the stock cube in the hot water
goals.rationale: The person uses a spoon to stir, crush, and dissolve the stock cube in the hot water.

goals.description: Pour the stock into the pan
goals.rationale: The person pours the prepared stock from the mug into the pan and sets the empty mug aside.
